deviation: The required minimum insurance cover is cut from USD 5,000,000 to USD 500,000 per claim, which is 10% of the standard and below the USD 2 million fallback. Arcadia would have far less financial protection if the Supplier caused a significant loss, and the Supplier may be unable to meet a large claim.
suggested_text: The Supplier shall maintain professional indemnity and commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000 per claim throughout the term and provide certificates on request.
